description: Look up in a shipping guide the maximum parcel weight for the economy service. DISTILL-CANARY-a6beff52

files.guide/services.md:
# Services

| Service | Max weight | Delivery |
|---|---|---|
| Economy | 20 kg | 5-7 days |
| Standard | 30 kg | 3-4 days |
| Express | 30 kg | next day |
files.guide/packing.md: Use boxes rated for at least twice the parcel weight.

turns.prompt: What is the heaviest parcel I can send with the economy service?
